name: Hylton
bio: A member of Wilde's Paris circle in December 1898, who arrived at the Hôtel d'Alsace 'with his boy Herbert' and whom Wilde found almost impossible - 'a sort of grown-up man with a hysterical womb', who made scenes with Sir John Ashton 'like a woman with child'.
bio_note: Found by reading printed 1107 whole after the General Index sent me there for Alphonse. **He is indexed nowhere** - neither in the Index of Recipients nor under his own name in the General Index - and would never have been found by any search.
